summary: Kontoor Brands filed an 8-K on May 6, 2026, announcing the planned divestiture of its Lee business, with results and outlook reflecting Lee as discontinued operations. The company initiated a competitive process to sell Lee, which generated approximately $750M in revenue. Separately, the Board authorized a new $750M share repurchase program, replacing the prior authorization. The filing includes Q1 FY2026 earnings; continuing ops revenue was $613M with Wrangler up 4% and Helly Hansen up 16% pro-forma. Lee's $195M quarterly revenue is now in discontinued ops. Full-year revenue guidance including discontinued ops is $3.41-$3.46B. Watch for buyer emergence and regulatory clearance to close the sale.
